description: This PHP file defines a class EmployeeAllowedLicenseSearchFilterParams in the OrangeHRM project, specifically within the PIM module's DTO namespace. The class extends a base FilterParams class and is used to encapsulate search filter parameters for employee allowed licenses, notably the employee number and sorting options.

classes.name: EmployeeAllowedLicenseSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object (DTO) class used for filtering search results for employee allowed licenses, including sorting and employee number filtering.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the search filter parameters and sets default sort field to 'l.name'.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the employee number used as a filter criterion.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter criterion.
